title: SG-3 Add lighting and atmosphere effects
summary: Moonlight shaft, lamp glow, door light, dust and vignette are built from scene content on the effects layer
description: Context: buildEffects (game/src/engine/buildEffects.ts) and createPhaserEffectContext (game/frontend/src/phaser/effectContext.ts) already support dust, ambientLight and transition effects. The bedroom scene declares only those. Desired behaviour: the bedroom also shows a moonlight shaft, lamp glow, light under the door and a soft vignette, all declared in content, drawn on the effects layer with palette colours, with dust using the generated effect:dust sprite, and every Phaser object destroyed on scene shutdown. Why: section 3.4 of the goal requires layered 2D lighting and particles.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bedroom scene content, when buildEffects runs with a mocked context, then createEffect is called once for each of dust, ambientLight, moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight and vignette, with depth equal to layerDepth('effects')
Given any created effect, when the scene shuts down, then destroy is called on every handle
Given the bedroom scene content, when its effect colours are read, then each colour is a member of PALETTE

preserve: existing dust, ambientLight and transition behaviour

technical_constraints: Scene content stays data-driven: no effect position or asset id hardcoded in a scene class
One shared palette of at most 48 colours
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with Act and Verify units green
